mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates an accelerating economic contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 30% of instances when INDPRO < 100 AND UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 35% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS increased by > 0.5% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increased by > 0.3pp from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 30% of instances when UNRATE increased by > 0.3pp from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% indicates a weakening housing market and labor market, which together drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 35% of instances when HOUST < 1700 AND UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized rate signals a slowing economy, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 < 0.5% (annualized).
